scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.source:firefox: mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && git archive --format=zip -o web-ext-artifacts/source.zip HEAD
scripts.sign:firefox: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code web-ext-artifacts/source.zip
scripts.publish:firefox: npm run lint:firefox && npm run source:firefox && npm run sign:firefox
